title: Potion Manager
description: Let your members use potions on command!
body:
# PotionManager

A Minecraft plugin for managing potion effects with a 4-tier permission system.  
Prior developer H1DD3NxN1NJA: Plugin at [Spigot](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/potion-manager-1-8-1-14-gui-potion-management-plugin.53225/)

[![Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/version-4.3.2-blue.svg)](https://github.com/veteranmina/PotionManager)
[![Minecraft](https://img.shields.io/badge/minecraft-1.21.11-green.svg)](https://www.spigotmc.org/)

**Installation**
---

1. Download from Modrinth or [Releases](https://github.com/veteranmina/PotionManager/releases)
2. Place in `plugins/` folder
3. Restart server

**Documentation**
---

See the [**Wiki**](https://github.com/veteranmina/PotionManager/wiki) for full documentation, commands, permissions, and configuration.

**Support**

- **Issues:** [Report bugs or request features](https://github.com/veteranmina/PotionManager/issues)
